jamal: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need concrete owners + a short triage appendix added to the playbook for the service-queue outage. High level: remediation steps, exact commands, and escalation contact chain. Who can own which bits?

sophia: I can take the runbook edits for 'service-queue' (triage steps + commands). Target: small PR with checklist by Wed EOD. :white_check_mark:

alex: I'll handle the alert thresholds + add a canary check that runs every 5m, and update the pager rules. ETA 48h.

jamal: thanks. can you include the quick query we used to spot the backlog? putting it in the runbook will help on-call.

alex: yep. sample query to check consumer lag:```sql
SELECT topic, partition, lag
FROM consumer_offsets
WHERE topic = 'service-queue'
ORDER BY lag DESC
```

kyle: i'll own the postmortem action tracker in JIRA (RW-3521) and link the runbook PR. Assigning owners in the ticket now.

tanvi: can someone paste the kubectl / systemctl commands we ran? new engineers need the exact commands to restart the worker safely.

jamal: the safe restart we used:```bash
# cordon drain not needed for short restart
kubectl rollout restart deployment/service-queue-worker -n prod
# if pod stuck, kill the pod so it re-schedules
kubectl delete pod <pod-name> -n prod --grace-period=0 --force
```

jamal: also add optional escalation to infra on-call if restart fails twice in a row. Escalation path we agreed: oncall -> eng-sre -> infra lead (pager).

oncall-bot: Paging eng-sre (primary) for escalation template. Use: "incident: service-queue degraded, failed restarts x2"

tanvi: perfect. i'll add a short section under "Triage -> Immediate checks" with that command + the SQL query and a one-line runbook snippet for the escalation path.

alex: for alerts: change threshold from 1000 to 500 lag, and add a 3m auto-silence window to reduce flapping. Also include an instructive log grep to spot OOM restarts:```bash
kubectl logs <pod> -n prod --since=1h | grep -i oom
```

jamal: owners and timelines recap: sophia -> runbook PR (Weds EOD), alex -> alert + canary (48h), tanvi -> triage commands + doc (tomorrow noon), kyle -> JIRA action tracker + links (today EOD). I'll validate runbook after PR and then add to playbook release cycle.

sophia: creating draft PR now, will ping here when it's ready for review. cc @alex @tanvi for the command snippets. :eyes:

kyle: RW-3521 updated with owners and due dates. added labels: postmortem, runbook-update, priority-high.

jamal: one more: add a recurring check on weekly on-call rotation to review that triage section for relevance (3 months cadence). makes sure we catch drift.

alex: added a TODO comment in alert config to include a link to the runbook once PR merges.

deploy-bot: Deployment started: runbook-update/sophia -> staging (sha: a1b2c3)

jamal: thanks all. we'll reconvene in the incident-followups doc next week to confirm close-out. If any owner needs more time, update RW-3521 and mention in this thread. :handshake:
